label: National financial accounts
description: The national financial accounts include a structured and coherent set of statistical information, which records financial transactions – flows and stocks – between the institutional sectors of the economy and between these sectors and the rest of the world, disaggregated by financial instrument

label: External statistics
description: External statistics measure the relationships between one economy and the outside world. They include the balance of payments statistics (transactions), international investment position statistics (positions) and international reserves statistics

label: Balance of payments
description: The statistics of the balance of payments reflect the economic transactions occurred between residents and non-residents for a certain period of time and comprise transactions on goods, services, income, unrequited transfers and financial operations

label: International investment position
description: The statistics of the international investment position reflect the value and composition of the financial assets and liabilities of the resident economy vis-à-vis the rest of the world at the end of a certain period of time. This statistic allow to calculate external debt

label: International reserves
description: The international reserves statistics comprise the external assets readily available and controlled by the monetary authority to meet the external financing needs of the country and are a main part of the Eurosystem external assets, for countries belonging to the European Monetary Union

label: Payment systems and instruments
description: Payments statistics include information on the use of payment instruments in Portugal and transactions processed through interbank clearing and settlement systems

label: Cash issuance
description: Cash issuance statistics provide information on the main stages of the cash lifecycle

label: Budget Outturn
description: Budget outturn is the set of operations that reflect the collection of expected revenue and the payment of expenses set out in the State Budget

label: National accounts
description: The national accounts comprise the financial and non-financial accounts of the economy covering the main macroeconomic variables and the relations between the resident institutional sectors and  the rest of the world

label: Consumer price index
description: The consumer price index (CPI) measures price changes in Portugal, based on a representative basket of goods and services typically consumed by resident households. This indicator makes it possible to monitor inflation and changes in the general price level of the Portuguese economy.

label: Population, employment and unemployment
description: Statistics on developments in resident population and labour force, employment and unemployment

label: Monetary and financial
description: Monetary and financial statistics present the monetary aggregates and their respective counterparts, balance sheets of monetary and non-monetary financial institutions and interest rates of banking

label: Financial markets
description: Financial markets statistics present information on securities issues and holdings, secondary market and exchange rates

label: General government
description: General government statistics present general government operations with various resident sectors of the economy and the rest of the world. They include namely, information about general government financing and general government debt

label: Indebtedness of the non-financial sector
description: Non-financial sector indebtedness measures the financial liabilities of non-financial sector entities towards all sectors of the economy and abroad, in the form of loans, debt securities and trade credits

label: Monetary financial institutions' balance sheet
description: The balance sheet of the monetary financial institutions statistics comprise the monetary aggregates, the balance sheet of Central Bank and the balance sheet of other monetary financial institutions (banks) and derive from the statistical accounting of the data of these institutions

label: Banking system information
description: The information about the Portuguese banking system regards the balance sheet and the income statement, aggregating data in a consolidated and individual basis (for the agents who do not consolidate accounts in Portugal)

label: Interest rates
description: The interest rates statistics translate the interest rates applied by banks in Portugal to loans and deposits

label: Money market
description: The money market statistics provide information on the euro money market on both the euro area and the Portuguese market segment

label: Other financial intermediaries, financial auxiliaries and captive financial institutions and money lenders balance sheet
description: Information on the statistical balance sheet of other financial intermediaries (except insurance companies and pension funds), financial auxiliaries and captive financial institutions and money lenders balance sheet

label: Investment funds balance sheet
description: Information on assets and liabilities of investment funds, broken down by investor, instrument and investment policies and investor sector

label: Secondary market
description: The secondary market statistics comprise transactions on the stock exchange or outside on securities that are in circulation

label: General government financing
description: The general government financing is an indicator that measures the cumulated flows, since the beginning of the year, of the general government liabilities net of its financial assets. Its value tends to approximate the symmetric of the balance of the general government budget

label: General government debt
description: The general government debt reflects the level of indebtedness of the general government, comprising its responsibilities vis-à-vis the other resident sectors of the economy and the rest of the world

label: Exchange rates
description: The exchange rate statistics reflect the prices of currencies against a reference currency and comprise daily and monthly exchange rates

label: Real effective exchange rate indices
description: The effective real exchange rate of the euro and the harmonised competitiveness indicators of different countries are price competitiveness indicators vis-à-vis the main trading partners

label: Time-series for the Portuguese economy - GDP and main components of expenditure
description: Quarterly time-series since 1977 for GDP and other main national accounts expenditure aggregates for Portugal

label: Time-series for the Portuguese economy - Household wealth
description: Annual time-series for the main components of household wealth in Portugal: Housing, financial assets and liabilities

label: Economic activity indicators
description: Economic activity indicators for monitoring the real economy developments and forecasting the main macroeconomic aggregates

label: Commodity prices
description: Commodity prices correspond to international markets prices and include the oil price and the non-energy commodity prices

label: Housing prices
description: Housing price statistics comprise indicators for the evolution of property transaction prices (new and existing dwellings) in Portugal

label: Prices
description: Price statistics include indicators on the prices evolution in Portugal: consumer, production and housing prices and national accounts deflators. For the HICP and real exchange rate indices it is possible the comparison between Portugal and the most relevant economic areas

label: Harmonised index of consumer prices
description: The harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP) measures price changes in Portugal and the other euro area countries, based on a harmonised methodology that ensures the comparability of inflation across countries. This indicator is used by the European Central Bank to assess price stability in the euro area.

label: Population and labour market
description: Statistics on population and labour market include a set of indicators of developments in population, employment, unemployment, compensation of employees and productivity in Portugal. For the main indicators comparable data for the euro area average is also available

label: Labour costs and productivity
description: Statistics on compensation of employees, unit labour costs (ratio of compensation per employee to productivity)  and productivity (ratio of real GDP to total employment) for Portugal and the euro area average

label: Time-series for the Portuguese economy - Household disposable income
description: Quarterly historical series since 1977 produced by the Banco de Portugal on some of the key components of disposable income and savings of private individuals (households and non-profit institutions serving households) in Portugal

label: Confidence indicators
description: European Commission qualitative indicators including the economic sentiment indicator, sectorial confidence indicators (industry , retail trade , services and construction) and the consumer's confidence indicator

label: Coincident indicators
description: Indicators produced by Banco de Portugal that cover the economic activity  and the private consumption coincident indicators

label: Sectorial indicators - Manufacturing
description: Quantitative indicators for the activity in the industrial sector, such as the Industrial Production Index, the I Industrial Turnover Index and the level of capacity utilisation in  manufacturing industry

label: Sectorial indicators - Trade
description: Quantitative indicators concerning the activity in trade, such as the retail trade turnover, the registrations of motor vehicles (passengers and commercial vehicles), the retail sales of gasoline and diesel and the consumption of electricity

label: Sectorial indicators - Services
description: Quantitative indicators concerning the activity in the services sector, such as the Services Turnover Index and the number of overnight stays in tourism accommodation sector (resident and nonresident costumers)

label: Sectoral indicators - Construction
description: Quantitative indicators concerning the activity in the construction sector, such as the cement sales and number of construction permits issued

label: International trade of goods
description: Imports and exports of goods by category of goods and region

label: GDP Expenditure approach
description: Information on gross domestic product (GDP) at market prices and main components of expenditure in Portugal and in the euro area (average and other EA countries)

label: GDP Production approach
description: Information on gross domestic product (GDP) at market prices for Portugal compiled according to the production-approach: gross value added (GVA) at basic prices broken down by main branches of activity, plus taxes minus subsidies on products

label: Net Lending/Net Borrowing
description: Information on the net lending/net borrowing of the economy, broken down by resident institutional sector, according to the non-financial national accounts approach

label: Income and saving
description: Information on the main components of the disposable income and savings in Portugal

label: Financial stability indicators
description: Indicators that intend to identify risks and vulnerabilities for the Portuguese Economy. These indicators include indicadors of the Banking System and also Financial Soundness Indicators (FSIs) published by the IMF. An indicator for financial stress in Portugal is also included

label: General government financial accounts
description: The general government financial accounts record the financial operations between this institutional sector, other sectors of the economy and the rest of the world, by financial instruments

label: Monetary policy
description: Monetary policy statistics present the aggregates concerning the money market and monetary policy instruments

label: Instruments
description: Monetary policy instruments statistics provide information on minimum reserves and excess reserves held by Portuguese credit institutions with Banco de Portugal

label: Time-series for the Portuguese economy - Employment (national accounts concept)
description: Quarterly historical series since 1977 produced by the Banco de Portugal for full-time equivalent employment in Portugal

label: Time-series for the Portuguese economy - Labour force, employment and unemployment
description: Quarterly historical series since 1977 produced by the Banco de Portugal on the labour force, employment and unemployment in Portugal

label: Globalisation statistics
description: Globalisation statistics search to capture the process of integration and internationalisation of both the markets and the Portuguese multinationals in a global approach. Include crucial information for the evaluation of different strategies, sustainability and risks

label: Foreign Direct Investment - Directional Principle
description: Foreign direct investment (FDI) statistics under the directional principle complement the traditional presentation of external statistics (assets/liability presentation). They are more appropriate for analyzing the motivations and impacts of the investment

label: Foreign Direct Investment - Ultimate Investor
description: Foreign direct investment (FDI) statistics by ultimate investing economy identifies the real origin of the investment; i.e., the countries that are, in last resort, and independently of the multinational group structure, controlling the investment, benefiting from income and assuming the risk.

label: National financial accounts - Interlinkages between sectors
description: Based on the national financial accounts information, it is possible to assess the financial interlinkages between the different institutional sectors and between these and the rest of the world

label: Corporations from the central balance-sheet database
description: Non-financial corporations statistics are part of a set of indicators about non-financial corporations, namely indicators about balance sheets and profit and loss account, as well as economic and financial ratios.

label: Quarterly economic and financial indicators of corporations
description: Quarterly economic and financial indicators comprise a set of ratios that allow for the analysis of the sector from the perspective of its profitability, activity and funding. These are based in a Quarterly Survey to Non-Financial Corporations and exclude agriculture and fishing.

label: Annual economic and financial indicators of corporations
description: Annual economic and financial indicators are presented by economic activity sector and comprise a set of indicators about profitability, activity, funding, liquidity and risk of the corporations. These are based in Simplified Corporate Information.

label: Central balance-sheet studies
description: Central balance sheet studies present indicators for sets of corporations, considered of interest for the understanding of the Portuguese non-financial corporations’ activity.

label: Non-financial accounts of General government
description: Information on non-financial accounts of the general government, namely on main revenues and expenditures or uses and resources of the sector under national accounts perspective

label: Economic and financial indicators of corporations by region
description: Regional economic and financial indicators are presented by economic activity sector and region and comprise a set of indicators about profitability, funding, liquidity and risk of the corporations. These are based in Simplified Corporate Information.

label: Investment and capital stock
description: Presents indicators on the value of economy’s fixed assets. Fixed assets refer to produced assets which are regularly used on production systems. Investment shows data on net acquisitions of fixed assets. Capital stock shows the balance of those assets available at a reference period

label: National accounts deflators
description: Statistics on the price developments underlying the main aggregates of national accounts expenditure and production in Portugal

label: Loans for house purchase
description: Statistics on loans for house purchase refer to loans for acquisition or construction of personal and permanent residential property, and include information on new loans and stock of loans, interest rates, reference rates and monthly repayments

label: Loans
description: Regional statistics on loans provide information on loans granted to households and NPISH and non-financial corporations, broken down by the borrower's region of residence

label: Inward direct investment
description: Inward direct investment (FDI) statistics by region splits the amount of FDI, indicating the Portuguese regions benefiting from this investment. The geographical locations of the units receiving FDI are considered.

label: Regional statistics
description: Regional statistics present a set of indicators by region regarding corporations, loans and foreign direct investment.

label: Securities issues
description: The securities issue statistics (primary market) comprise information related with the securities (listed shares and debt securities) issued by resident entities in domestic and foreign markets in its various components (net issues and stocks)

label: Nominal exchange rate indices
description: The nominal effective exchange rates indices statistics are a measure of synthesis of the external value of a currency against the currencies of major trading partners

label: Securities holdings
description: Securities holdings’ statistics comprise information on securities’ holders

label: Deposits
description: Regional statistics on deposits consist of deposits from households and NPISH and non-financial corporations, broken down by the location of the branch associated with the deposit (including deposits not domiciled at a physical branch). Details of deposits made by emigrants are also available

label: Interest rates by sector of economic activity
description: Interest rate statistics on new loans granted by resident banks to Portuguese non-financial corporations, grouped by sector of economic activity (CAE) and complemented with loan indicators from the monetary financial institutions’ balance sheet domain.

label: Consumer credit
description: Consumer credit statistics cover loans granted by banks and other financial institutions to private individuals for non-commercial or non-professional purposes, to finance the acquisition of consumer goods (including personal loans, car loans and revolving credit).
